In this guide we will use the Wallet SDK to integrate with the Stellar blockchain and connect to anchors.

<Note>

This documentation walks you through how to build a wallet without using smart contracts. To build with smart contracts, navigate to the [Smart Contracts section](../../smart-contracts/overview).
